coder_notes: Temozolomide is given only in experimental Arm 3 as the established chemotherapy partner of pumitamig (not investigated in its own dose/schedule); coded soc_backbone. Regimen coded combination because Arm 3 adds temozolomide; Arm 1 is pumitamig monotherapy. Bevacizumab is the registered ACTIVE_COMPARATOR arm; Arm 2 patients may later cross over to pumitamig. PK outcomes (Cmax/Cmin of pumitamig) do not state the sample type, so tumour_pk_planned coded unclear per W7; likely systemic. PD-L1/VEGF-A appear only as keywords describing the drug's targets, not as a tumour biomarker requirement, so not listed as biomarkers.
